content: A principle is a principle only when it is kept even when it loses you money or comfort.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
explanation:
In this profound teaching from Speeches of Mahatma Gandhi, Mahatma Gandhi cuts through superficial illusion to reveal a foundational truth of human character. When we operate from fear, distraction, or narrow self-interest, our potential remains fragmented and fragile. By anchoring attention in principles, we awaken an unshakeable clarity that transforms how we navigate hardship and purpose.

True wisdom is never an abstract academic debate; it is an active discipline forged in the quiet arena of daily choices. When your internal conviction matches your outward conduct, the entire trajectory of your life shifts toward lasting strength and peace.
practicalInsight: Take deliberate ownership of your principles today. Strip away trivial distractions and act with steady, uncompromising integrity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you apply greater principles to the primary challenge facing your life right now?
